skills.description_en: Use when an approved supplier selection needs contract terms, version control, deviation review, legal or finance approval routing, and signature preparation; not for creating or releasing a PO.
skills.description_zh: 根据选商结果生成合同条款与版本，完成偏差和审批准备；不生成采购订单，也不自动签署。

skills.description_en: Use when arrived goods or completed services need quantity, condition, quality, document, and acceptance-criteria checks; not for delivery tracking, invoice verification, or payment approval.
skills.description_zh: 对照合同和订单检查交付数量、时间、状态、质量与文件，记录差异和证据；最终验收、拒收或例外接收由授权人员决定。

skills.description_en: Use when a released purchase order needs supplier confirmation, expected delivery, logistics or service milestones, delay, exception, and expediting records; not for accepting delivery.
skills.description_zh: 跟踪订单确认、预计交付、物流或服务里程碑、延期、异常和催交记录；不负责收货或验收。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved procurement contract needs a purchase-order draft, line and total validation, approval routing, release control, or PO status record; not for drafting contract terms.
skills.description_zh: 根据已批准合同生成采购订单，校验 PO 内容、审批、释放和状态记录；不负责合同条款设计。

skills.description_en: Use when RFQ responses need completeness checks, line normalization, currency and commercial-term comparison, or a comparison table; not for qualification, composite supplier scoring, or selection.
skills.description_zh: 只负责报价完整性、行项目、币种、税费、运费、折扣、付款与交付条款的标准化商业比较，不负责供应商综合评分或选商。

skills.description_en: Use when a business need must become a versioned, supplier-neutral procurement requirement before finance budget checking; not for technical specification approval, sourcing, or ordering.
skills.description_zh: 将业务采购需求整理为可追踪、可比较、供应商中立的需求文件，明确规格、验收标准、证据缺口与审批状态。

skills.description_en: Use when an approved procurement requirement and admitted supplier list need an RFQ draft, inquiry scope, quotation template, deadline, and recipient list; not for sending or comparing quotes.
skills.description_zh: 根据采购需求和技术规格生成 RFQ、询价范围、报价模板、截止日期与供应商发送清单；不负责发送或比价。

skills.description_en: Use when completed deliveries or review periods need post-award supplier performance evaluation, improvement planning, or rating review; not for pre-award qualification, scoring, or selection.
skills.description_zh: 基于交付、质量、服务、商务表现和合规证据评价供应商，展示评分与证据覆盖率；不得自动续约、停用或拉黑。

skills.description_en: Use when discovered supplier candidates need qualification, compliance, risk, capacity, and admission checks; not for supplier discovery, quote scoring, award, or post-delivery evaluation.
skills.description_zh: 对候选供应商进行资质、合规、风险、能力和准入检查；不负责搜索、报价评分、选商或履约评价。

skills.description_en: Use when qualified suppliers need an evidence-backed pre-award score across qualification, price, delivery, quality, and risk; not for quote normalization, selection, or post-delivery evaluation.
skills.description_zh: 综合资质、价格、交付、质量与风险形成供应商评分表；与报价标准化和最终选商分离。

department_grouping.en: Department grouping expresses ownership only. It does not define an executable Skill, hierarchy, route, or execution order.
department_grouping.zh: 部门分组只表示归属，不定义可执行 Skill、层级、路线或执行顺序。

prerequisite.en: When its stated scope and any stated condition apply, before must precede after.
prerequisite.zh: 仅当给定 scope 和可选 condition 适用时，before 才必须先于 after。

conflict.en: When gate_skill produces the stated failure condition, blocked_skill must not continue.
conflict.zh: 当 gate_skill 产生指定失败条件时，必须阻止 blocked_skill 继续。

mutex.en: Within the same business object and the same stated context, only one of skill_a and skill_b may be selected.
mutex.zh: 在同一业务对象和同一 context 内，skill_a 与 skill_b 只能选择一条路线。

enhances.en: source may optionally improve target in the stated context; it is not a mandatory prerequisite.
enhances.zh: 在给定 context 中，source 可选地增强 target；它不是强制前置。
